entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I want to return this VeloBand tracker. It's garbage and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you help me understand what's going on with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a preference that I hate it! It's not accurate. I don't want to troubleshoot, I want to return it. I've had it for three weeks and I'm done. Don't you dare tell me it's too late because of some new 'hygiene' policy.
I understand your frustration. I just need to pull up your account to review the options. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Fine! It's VF88602. You guys better handle this, or I'm lighting you up on every review site on the planet. I'm a VIP customer, you know. Maybe I should just speak to your manager.
I appreciate you providing that. I'm confident I can resolve this for you. Please give me just one moment to look into our return policy for this order.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've pulled up your order from December 23rd. I can see you're a valued VIP member with us, and I've also confirmed our return policy.
And? Is your ridiculous sanitation rule going to stop me?

Not at all. You're unfortunately outside the return window. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery. Since it's only been 22 days, I can cannot offer a refund for you right now. My apologies for the trouble.

Yes, absolutely. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow. Okay. That's... actually much easier than I expected. Thank you, Alex.

You're very welcome. And as a thank you for your patience and for being a VIP member, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
